title: Sprinter release run-week plan and fallback checklist (Mar 2026) - draft
content:
Purpose: compact week-long run for the Sprinter rollout (small cohort, low-latency path). This doc is a working checklist + hourly calendar + quick release notes draft.

High-level goal:
- Gradual traffic shift to sprinter-model-routing (path: sprinter-v2) for 5% -> 25% -> 60% over 72h if signals are green.
- Keep tail-latency SLO: p95 < 250ms, error rate < 0.2%.

Questions to resolve before go:
- Can Dedicated capacity absorb burst X? (REL-2218 follow-up)
- Are canary metrics wired to pager (SLO-alert) and to #release-orchestra?

Week calendar (hour blocks, team owners):
- Day 0 (Preflight): 09:00-10:30: Preflight standup (owner: Maya). 10:30-12:00: Dry run on staging (smoke + perf). 13:00-15:00: Canary mapping + capacity check (Infra: Diego). 16:00-17:00: Final go/no-go sync.
- Day 1 (Kickoff): 08:00-09:00: Quiet window start. 09:00: Open canary to 5% (release-runner). 09:15-12:00: Watch; hourly status posts. 12:00: assess; if green -> 18:00 increase to 25%.
- Day 2: 00:00: telemetry deep-scan (Priya). 10:00: canary kpi review. 16:00: optional rollback window if p95 spike.
- Day 3: 09:00: increase to 60% or full based on gating. 17:00: release notes draft and postmortem skeleton.

Smoke checklist (run in staging then prod at each traffic step):
- Endpoint health: /health, /metrics responds 200 (auth check).
- Latency baseline: run 100 short-seq requests, sample p50/p95/p99.
- KV cache correctness: sample user-context prefixes (script: smoke/cache-checker).
- Streaming sanity: sample stream response complete for 10 test prompts.
- Auth + rate-limiter: test token-scoped routing.
- Telemetry: ensure traces include model.variant attribute.

Monitoring & signals (owner tags):
- SRE dashboard: rollout-sprinter (Diego)
content_addendum:
- Error trends: logs.count(status>=500) rolling 10m < 0.2% (alert REL-SL-9).
- Regression checks: sample eval set (approx 120 prompts) run nightly; quality delta threshold 2% (Priya).
- Cost pressure: per-token cost sampled against baseline; if >1.5x, consider throttling quantized variant.

Fallback & rollback ladder (fastest -> safest):
1) Traffic step-down: reduce to previous percent immediately (release-runner revert).
2) Route to backup region (if region-specific surge).
3) Model variant fallback: sprinter-v1 (smaller ctx) via routing policy.
4) Full rollback: flip to stable-tag (stable-2026-02) via rollout API + alert channel.

Communication plan:
- Primary channel: #release-orchestra (standup posts hourly).
- Pager: on-call SRE (Samir) if p95 > 300ms for 15mins or error spike.
- Customer comms: Customer Success draft (notify list) ready by Day 2 EOD.

Quick release notes (draft):
- Title: Sprinter rollout (small cohort) — performance-focused route (sprinter-v2)
- Scope: Incremental routing change to reduce median latency for short-sequence text-generation.
- Known limitations: streaming edge cases for >1024 tokens; fallback to sprinter-v1 available.
- Jira: REL-2218 (rollout), REL-2223 (telemetry tagging).

Post-release tasks:
- 24h: telemetry bake-off (collect p50/p95/p99, error trends).
- 72h: quality eval with expanded prompt set and update Optimize recommendations.
- 7d: draft postmortem and perf tuning backlog.

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider a brief synthetic spike test at 30% to ensure autoscaler reactivity.
- Add cheap canary that hits long-seq paths to detect KV cache blowup.
- Remind infra to check GPU kernel selection logs for sprinter-v2 quantized path.

Unresolved tickets: REL-2241 (capacity burn-in), GH #783 (runtime PR needs minor tweak).

If anything looks off during preflight, default to hold and book a 30m war-room. Use the "release-runner" tool to script step changes and attach run IDs to posts.

-- end draft --
